notes: New defaults: 23.976 fps and 30 seconds. If you never changed the old defaults (30 fps, 10 seconds), they switch over automatically.
The Frame rate menu now works and lists the same rates as After Effects' Composition Settings: 8, 12, 15, 23.976, 24, 25, 29.97, 30, 50, 59.94, 60 and 120. You can still type any rate.
23.976, 29.97 and 59.94 now create comps at AE's exact NTSC rates, matching AE's own presets.
New setting: Open all comps after import (on by default). Turn it off to open only the first comp.
The Figma panel is a little taller so all settings fit without scrolling.
testFocus: This is the first automatic update: reopening After Effects should show “Updated to 0.1.1”, and re-running the Figma plugin should show BUILD 0.1.1.
Frame rate menu: click the arrow and pick each rate; check the comp's frame rate in AE's Composition Settings, especially 23.976 and 29.97.
Open all comps after import: send 3–5 frames with it on (every comp opens as a tab, the first one in front), then off (only the first opens).
